title: Tile collision data consumed by src/sim/world.ts

meta.description: Optional facts for facades and storefronts (year built, use, stories, source ids). Never read by the sim. The keys below are the pipeline's (docs/data-sources.md); other worlds may add their own.

footY.description: Lowest ground under the footprint minus 5 cm: where walls start so nothing floats

heightM.description: Height of this record's roof above the building's ground reference, metres

lidarM.description: LiDAR [median, max] height above ground, metres (2010 survey)

parcel.description: Assessor parcel (block + lot) joined to the footprint

stories.description: Storeys, when the assessor's count agrees with the measured height

units.description: Units on the parcel, or condominium units on the building

condo.description: The joined parcel is one unit of a condominium building

tower.description: On a podium record: the id of its tower record

towerOf.description: On a "-tower" record: the podium record's id

podiumTopY.description: On a "-tower" record: the podium's roof (absolute y)

water.description: Optional per-sample open-water flags, same layout as heights (1 = open water at sea level, 0 = land)
